title: Terminal header: a message icon shows when the Injector or a trigger sends a message, until the person clears it
story: When you send a message from the Injector panel, or a trigger sends one, each terminal that received it now shows a small amber envelope on its header, with a count from two messages on. Hovering lists who sent each message, when, and its first line; clicking the envelope clears it, and nothing else does. The messages are kept in memory only and go when the terminal closes or Maestro restarts. Before, a delivered message left no mark on the terminal.

checks.criterion: A successful Injector send adds an amber icon after the terminal name, with a count from two on; a failed send adds nothing
checks.steps: Start Maestro and launch two terminals in a demo project. Open the Injector from the left icon strip. Tick both terminals, type 'hello demo' and click 'Inject into 2 terminals'. Send 'second note' the same way to one terminal only.
checks.expected: Both headers show an amber envelope right after the name (after the red context icon when shown); the terminal that got both shows 2 beside it.

checks.criterion: Hover lists every message newest first, then 'Click to dismiss'
checks.steps: After the first check, hover the envelope on the terminal that got both messages.
checks.expected: Three lines: 'Injector · HH:MM · second note', 'Injector · HH:MM · hello demo', 'Click to dismiss'.

checks.criterion: Clicking the icon clears every message; clicking or typing in the terminal does not
checks.steps: Click inside the terminal, type ls, click the header, check the icon, then click the envelope.
checks.expected: The icon stays until the envelope is clicked, then disappears.

checks.criterion: A trigger firing adds a message from 'Trigger at N%'
checks.steps: In the Injector add a trigger on one terminal at 1% with message 'trigger demo'; send that terminal a prompt so its context passes 1%.
checks.expected: The envelope appears; hover shows 'Trigger at 1% · HH:MM · trigger demo'.

checks.criterion: A closed terminal's messages are dropped and nothing survives a restart
checks.steps: Inject into a terminal, park it, unpark it, check the icon; close it and launch a new one; restart Maestro.
checks.expected: The icon survives park and unpark; the new terminal has none; no icons after restart.
